title: Gudea Uses AI to Track Online Rumors and Prevent Crises
excerpt: Gudea is utilizing artificial intelligence to help organizations monitor online conversations and stop social media controversies early.
body_html:
A company called Gudea is using artificial intelligence to help organizations stop public controversies before they grow. The platform functions as a storm tracker for the internet by monitoring digital conversations and websites worldwide.

Online discussions often feature damaging rumors, hate speech, or AI-generated misinformation. Small posts on these topics can rapidly expand into major public relations issues for businesses and other groups.

By tracking how these stories and rumors spread across online spaces, Gudea aims to provide organizations with the insights needed to address potential issues early.
